user_clarification: 六个跨域实验设置，三个候选创新点；学习经典算法的思想为论文提供理论支撑，不是用经典算法校准判断。
terminology: three candidate innovations in one unified framework, evaluated in six cross-domain experimental settings

candidate_innovations.name: 覆盖与疑点共同驱动的主动观察
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 先形成场景覆盖，再集中细看疑点
candidate_innovations.task_design: Define query-candidate coverage units and genuinely new observations, coupled to evidence groups and structural residuals.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: Frozen equal-cost coverage batches have a monotone submodular objective; greedy bound applies only if actually implemented with those assumptions.

candidate_innovations.name: 相关性受控的证据推理
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 重复听到同一判断不等于获得独立证据，少量可疑反馈可被纠正
classical_principles: 相关证据的信息量约束
candidate_innovations.task_design: Task-specific exact-request deduplication and bounded group influence; distinguish regularization from independent Bayesian evidence.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: Fixed-unary strongly convex robust inference admits a conditional single-group stability bound; current DS and group means do not instantiate that theorem.

candidate_innovations.name: 视觉与语言关系约束下的结构化适配
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 用外观、身份与描述间的关系交叉检查判断
candidate_innovations.task_design: Conservative visual-language relations with explicit scope, uncertainty and task-contract conditions.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: Correct convex relations give a squared-error projection property; relation misspecification adds an explicit risk term; neither proves HOTA improvement.

evaluation: Same method and parameter rules across settings; shared-budget ordinary distillation, three leave-one-module-out ablations and necessary interaction/quantity controls. A module need not improve every setting separately.
